response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.type AS type, t.amount AS amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06'), r AS (SELECT region, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM j GROUP BY region) SELECT region, avg_signed, txn_count, avg_signed / (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) FROM r) AS ratio_to_overall FROM r WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) FROM r) IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The date range is inclusive at both ends. trans.date is compared as text in YYYY-MM-DD format, with no time component.

The overall average is the unweighted mean of the regional averages. Regions with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions have a NULL average and are skipped in that mean. They still appear in the output with their transaction count and a NULL ratio.
VYBER and other non-PRIJEM/VYDAJ types are left out of the average, because the request excludes any type other than PRIJEM and VYDAJ. They are still counted in the transaction count.
